questions.question: You and your friends were discussing some topic and they started ignoring your point. You will ___________.
questions.questionHtml: You and your friends were discussing some topic and they started ignoring your point. You will ___________.

options.text: start arguing with them because they are ignoring you.
options.html: start arguing with them because they are ignoring you.

options.text: use logical and strong points to support your point.
options.html: use logical and strong points to support your point.

options.text: start irritating them in some way.
options.html: start irritating them in some way.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3: use logical and strong points to support your point.

Statement Correctness Reasoning
start arguing with them because they are ignoring you. Incorrect It is incorrect because you can't handle the situation when people start ignoring you.
walk from there Incorrect This shows that you don't have points to prove that you are correct.
use logical and strong points to support your point. Correct This shows that you are confident enough to prove that you right by giving exacts facts and stats.

start irritating them in some way.

 Incorrect This shows that you are not a team player and you lose your mind when you are proved wrong.

 

  • Qualities Projected in this situation:  (Self-confidence, Knowledge, and Reasoning Ability)

Key Points

  • Checklist for attempting SRT questions:
  1. Read the question and options carefully.
  2. Look for options that are realistic, optimistic, and reflect officer-like qualities.
  3. Do not skip any situation.
  4. Relegate the negative sentences and choose the most logical option among the remaining. As time is an important factor, hence your thinking ability should be swift.
  5. React quickly and be logical.

II. Some blue are pink.

II. All pink are cherry.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:

questions.question: If : 49 ¥ 7 × 7 = 14, and 144 ¥ 6 × 6 = 30, then the value of 56 ¥ 8 × 3 =?
questions.questionHtml: If : 49 ¥ 7 × 7 = 14, and 144 ¥ 6 × 6 = 30, then the value of 56 ¥ 8 × 3 =?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

49 ¥ 7 → 49 ÷ 7 = 7;

 7 × 7 → 7 + 7 = 14.

And

144 ¥ 6 → 144 ÷ 6 = 24;

24 × 6 → 24 + 6 = 30.

Similarly,

56 ¥ 8 → 56 ÷ 8 = 7;

7 × 3 → 7 + 3 = 10

Hence, 10 is the correct answer

questions.question: Which of the following interchange of signs would make the equation correct? 70 + 15 ÷ 80 × 3 - 100 = 370
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following interchange of signs would make the equation correct?

70 + 15 ÷ 80 × 3 - 100 = 370
questions.solution:
Given equation is → 70 + 15 ÷ 80 × 3 - 100 = 370

After replacing the signs from left to right and using the BODMAS rule,

Option 1 → × and ÷ 

70 + 15 × 80 ÷ 3 - 100 = 370

70 + 15 × 26.66 - 100 = 370

70 + 399.9 - 100 = 370

469.9 - 100 = 370

369.9 = 370 

369.9 approximately = 370

370 = 370 

Option 2 → + and -

70 - 15 ÷ 80 × 3 + 100 = 370

70 - 0.875 × 3 + 100 = 370

70 - 2.625 + 100 = 370

170 - 2.625 = 370

167.375 ≠ 370 

Option 3 → × and -

70 + 15 ÷ 80 - 3 × 100 = 370

70 + 0.875 - 3 × 100 = 370

70 + 0.875 - 300 = 370

70.875 - 300 = 370

-229.125 ≠ 370

Option 4 → + and ÷

70 ÷ 15 + 80 × 3 - 100 = 370

4.66 + 80 × 3 - 100 = 370

4.66 + 240 - 100 = 370

244.66 - 100 = 370

144.66 ≠ 370

 Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
